text_block_list.text:
Registration for Dorowa is over here!
Please only enter the hall once you've
checked off your name on the registe— ah…!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Good evening, Nature-san!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Woah,
Chiyo-chan's dress is adorbs!
What's up with this? Oh, a sakura motif?!
text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Friend A

text_block_list.text:
Yup. Sakura. 
Sakura that spent its days alongside light
snowfall.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
…Chiyono O-san sure is popular. 
But… hehe. You're her number one, aren't you,
Ardan-san?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Yes. "Right now", that is.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
But, I understand that the one who will
spend her life pursuing her isn't me.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: …Huh?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: That's why I won't forget this night.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Even if throughout our lives we find that
we were not eachother's number one,
for just this one special night,
we were able to become eachother's
irreplaceable partners.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Tonight, just for this very moment,
with our arms intertwined,
the one reflected in her eyes will be me.
And the one reflected in my eyes will be
her.… I won't let anyone take that away from
me.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
…Even if that "number one" were to show up
in front of your very eyes?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Exactly, Nature-san.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you, too,
have someone whose gaze you want all to
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow… did you see Teio and McQueen just
now?! They're seriously on another level.
text_block_list.name: Attending Umamusume A

text_block_list.text:
I know, right?
They're definitely gonna be tonight's Best
Date! As for us,
well… how about we just take it slow for
now?
text_block_list.name: Attending Umamusume B

text_block_list.text: Let us proceed to the dance floor, too.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Okay. Also… Ardan-san!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Please don't hold yourself back anymore.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I learned with my body how good you are at
dancing. And now,
I've made myself remember how you dance.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Even if you decide to adlib some steps,
I'll follow right along.
Don't feel like you have to match my rhythm.
You should dance like you.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
We're going to go out there as Sakura Chiyono
O and Mejiro Ardan.
And we're gonna dance together!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Then, without further ado…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Look at me, Chiyono O-san.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Of course, Ardan-san.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
